messages.subject: Re: Error:  missing value where TRUE/FALSE needed
parts:
Also, so given data that are missing massively at random, the range() function will break without using na.rm=TRUE, after which it returns the correct vector.

So I think this gets resolved in the output$y_range_slider:

  output$y_range_slider <- renderUI({
    ymin <- floor(min(hw[[input$y_var]], na.rm=TRUE))
    ymax <- ceiling(max(hw[[input$y_var]], na.rm=TRUE))
 
    sliderInput(inputId = "y_range",
                label = paste("Limit range"),
                min = ymin, max = ymax, value = c(ymin, ymax))
  })
